definitions: To lay hold of; to grasp with the hands or otherwise; to seize or capture.
To get into one's possession by force or skill.
To receive into one's body, e.g., food, drink, medicine.
To carry or transport from one place to another.
To accept or receive something offered or given.
To perform an action or task.
To occupy a place or position.
To understand or interpret something in a particular way.
examples: Please take your books with you.
She took the bus to work.
It takes courage to speak up.
Don't take my words the wrong way.
